event: Nala goes still again and listens for the word kerith.
prose: You go still again under the hand and listen, this time for one word only. Kerith.

event: Her mother murmurs to her through the belly in the strange tongue, soft and slow.
prose: Your mother starts to murmur. Her voice is so close it seems to come from inside the walls, soft and slow, in the same language as before, and she seems to be talking to you.

memory.fact: Alone, her mother murmured to her through the walls in the same language, soft and slow.

event: Between murmurs her mother hums snatches of a low tune.
prose: Between the murmurs she hums, a few notes of some low tune at a time, and then she talks again.

memory.fact: Between murmurs her mother hummed a few notes of a low tune at a time.

event: The hand on the belly moves in slow circles as her mother murmurs.
prose: The small hand on the wall beside you moves as she talks, round and round in slow circles.

memory.fact: As her mother talked, her small hand on the belly moved round in slow circles.

event: Her mother says kerith, softly, then again a little later, the same two sounds as the man's.
prose: Then it comes, soft, in the middle of a murmur. "Kerith." The same two sounds the man made. A little later she says it again.

memory.fact: Murmuring alone, her mother said kerith too, the same two sounds the man made.
Murmuring alone, her mother said kerith too, the same two sounds the man made.

event: Her mother rises; the womb sways with each step as she walks a while.
prose: After a while the hand lifts and the whole world tips. Your mother is getting up. Then she walks, and the warm dark sways around you, one way and then the other, with every step she takes.

memory.fact: Her mother got up and walked, and the womb swayed with every step.
Her mother got up and walked, and the womb swayed with every step.

event: A door opens, and many voices rise at once around her, with the clatter of bowls.
prose: A door opens with a dull knock of wood. Then voices rise all around you at once, dozens of them, talking over each other, with a clatter of bowls under the noise.

memory.fact: Through a door her mother went in among dozens of voices talking at once, and clattering bowls.
